nom: Reminder of a return to send
quand: Sent by the Returns role one week after a return request, if the parcel has not reached the atelier yet: once per return.
preheader: Your parcel has not reached the atelier yet.

suivi.description: The order tracking link, where the label is

blocs.texte:
Hello {prenom},

You asked us for a return on your order {commande}, and your parcel has not reached the atelier yet.

Your return label is waiting in your order tracking: {suivi}

If you have changed your mind or something bothers you, simply reply to this message.

With all our care,
The Awrea Paris atelier
